reading: Slope range 0.0478..0.0491 across three independent full-pipeline runs - a spread of 0.0014, smaller than the width of any single run's cluster interval. Every run clears the frozen 0.05 margin (worst 0.1003); every null control sits at chance. The published run is the LOWEST of the three on both top rung and margin, so seed choice did not flatter it.
why: Preregistration 0003's frozen scope said 'single seed... this is not a variance study' - the most-repeated disclosed weakness in the package. These are full-pipeline replications at independent seeds: a fresh grouped split, fresh shuffles, fresh model initialisation each run. They cannot revise 0003's verdict; they measure whether a rerun would have said something different.
